newsitem.title: USA: Ecolab sees record results in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Ecolab sees record results in 1997.

text.p: Ecolab Inc said Monday it expects to post record results in 1997.

Ecolab, which markets premium cleaning, sanitizing and maintenance products and services, on Monday reported record fourth quarter earnings of $0.47 a share, up from $0.39 a year ago. For the full year, it earned a record $1.75, up from $1.50.
"All of our operations -- domestic, international and the (Henkel-Ecolab) joint venture -- turned in strong performances," Allan Schuman, president, said in a statement.

He added that the company met or exceeded each of its financial objectives, with earnings per share growth of 17 percent in full-year 1996, return on beginning equity of 25 percent and a continued investment-grade rating of its balance sheet.
Ecolab said its fourth quarter U.S. sales rose to $300.7 million from $265.7 million, while international sales increased to $90.4 million from $83.7 million.
For the full year, U.S. sales rose to $1.15 billion from $1.03 billion, and international sales increased to $341.2 million from $310.8 million.

U.S. operating income in the fourth quarter rose to $44.9 million from $37.5 million, and international operating income rose to $6.0 million from $5.7 million. Full-year U.S. operating income rose to $164.9 million from $147.3 million, and international operating income increased to $23.9 million from $19.6 million.
Ecolab said as of December 31 it had about 2.4 million shares remaining under an existing buyback authorization.
